Hedensted is a Danish municipality included in the national clinical quality benchmarking for atrial fibrillation treatment. In the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK), published by the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP), Hedensted is evaluated alongside all 98 Danish municipalities to assess local healthcare quality and facilitate benchmarking [^src1]. 

Specifically, Hedensted's data regarding stroke (apoplexy) events among atrial fibrillation patients is utilized in the DanStroke-based calculations for Indicator 5, which measures the prevention of ischemic strokes through anticoagulant (AK) treatment [^src1]. According to the report's detailed municipal breakdown on page 95, Hedensted's recorded metrics for this indicator include 4 events out of a population of 1,092 patients (with a rate of 0.4) and 10 events out of 1,114 patients (with a rate of 0.9) [^src1]. 

Because the available data is limited to this single statistical mention in the 2022–2023 reporting period, no further historical, relational, or contextual details about the municipality are documented in this corpus.
